scripts.build:frontend: node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('firebase-applet-config.json', 'frontend/src/firebase-applet-config.json')" && BROWSER=none npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.dev: node -e "import('fs').then(fs => { if (!fs.existsSync('frontend/build/index.html')) import('child_process').then(cp => cp.execSync('npm run build:frontend', { stdio: 'inherit' })); })" && node server.js
scripts.start: node -e "import('fs').then(fs => { if (!fs.existsSync('frontend/build/index.html')) import('child_process').then(cp => cp.execSync('npm run build:frontend', { stdio: 'inherit' })); })" && node server.js
